ValidationRule.description: Allow only relevant approved approved amount categories based on Expense Category
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Expense' && (ISPICKVAL( Status ,'Approved') || ISPICKVAL( Status ,'Rejected')) && (Total_Approved_Amount__c > ( IF( INCLUDES( Expense_Category__c, 'Accommodation'), NULLVALUE(Approved_Accommodation_Amount__c, 0) , 0) + IF(INCLUDES( Expense_Category__c, 'Meals'), NULLVALUE(Approved_Meal_Amount__c, 0), 0) + IF(INCLUDES( Expense_Category__c, 'Transport'), NULLVALUE(Approved_Transport_Amount__c, 0), 0) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Approved Amount must align with the Expense Category provided
